about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know me better
paragraphs: I'm a developer passionate about building modern, functional and well-designed web and mobile applications. I mainly work with **React**, **TypeScript**, **React Native** and **Node.js**, and I enjoy building solutions where user experience and system logic carry the same weight.

I like going beyond just making a feature work: **I enjoy understanding the logic behind every problem**, optimizing processes and designing scalable, maintainable applications. I'm always learning new tools and best practices to keep growing as a **Full Stack** developer and build quality products.
